## Summary

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues and applicable
requirement identifiers.

## Changes

List the changes needed to review this pull request. Identify documentation,
public API, or compatibility effects.

## Verification

For production behavior, describe the Given-When-Then slice and provide the
expected failing acceptance result before implementation, the passing result,
and relevant regression results.

For documentation or UI mocks, describe wording, link, or visual review.
Tests are not required for those artifacts.

## Accessibility

For component changes, provide automated results and manual verification for
JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, and Narrator. Include platform, browser, screen
reader version, steps, and results.

Mark this section not applicable for changes that do not affect a component.
Identify any incomplete required checks.

## Limitations

Describe remaining concerns or follow-up work. Use synthetic data and remove
private information from attached evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md.
- [ ] Requirements, acceptance criteria, and implementation remain aligned.
- [ ] Applicable verification is complete and documented.
- [ ] Documentation and rendered diagrams are updated where affected.
- [ ] External material has appropriate licenses and attribution.
